technique_name: Formulate a marketing plan for a new mobile app.
description: The marketing plan for the new mobile app should include creating an online presence on relevant social media and digital platforms. Promote the app by launching a website, creating teaser campaigns and targeted content. Use influencer marketing on YouTube and other popular streaming services to spread the word.
